newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index drops 6.22 percent.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index drops 6.22 percent.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index dropped 6.22 percent to 79.09 points after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index fell 76.32 points, or 2.14 percent to a 3,486.66 provisional close.
The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market was 13.25 percent after 11.28 percent on Monday.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
